description: This file defines the FilterInvestModifyEvent class, which extends Symfony's Event class, and manages the old and new states of an investment object within the Goteo application. It appears to be part of event handling related to investment modifications.

classes.name: FilterInvestModifyEvent
classes.description: An event class encapsulating old and new investment data for modifications in the Goteo application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with an Invest object, setting both old and new investment states.

methods.name: getOldInvest
methods.description: Returns the previous state of the investment.

methods.name: getNewInvest
methods.description: Returns the new state of the investment, cloned from the original at construction.
